item.description: Republican Governor Phil Scott won a sixth term as Vermont governor with Molly Gray winning lieutenant governor. Democrats flipped multiple legislative seats across the state. U.S. Representative Becca Balint was also reelected easily.

Jeff Haylon won the Rutland-nine House District race .Alicia Malay won a second term in the Rutland-eight House District. David Bosch and Thomas Burditt are likely winners in the Rutland-two House race. Jonathan Hescock leads Jim Casey in the Addison-Rutland House race. Phoebe Tucker won the Rutland-Windsor House District seat.

David Wolk won a Rutland County Senate seat as an independent. He previously served in the Vermont Senate and retired as Castleton University president. Republican Brian Collamore was re-elected, while Sen. Terry Williams appears to have lost.

Vermont voters approved a constitutional amendment protecting labor union rights. Over seventy-five percent supported Proposition three. The amendment guarantees the right to organize or join unions for collective bargaining.
